action_summary: The last source in the loop that could contain what the artifact does not is the author's own statement. This round asks whether it says what the behaviour SHOULD BE, and answers by construction: quoted literals in the commit body become inputs, exception and identifier names become expectations, and a pin built from the statement ALONE must pass at the fixed state and fail at the reverted one. Result over two corpora: the statement names the changed hunk on 6 of 11 and 4 of 8 residual parts (54.5% and 50.0%) and specifies an expected outcome on 0 of 19, with zero candidates walked because the commit bodies are titles. The three statements that do quote something belong to fixes whose own suites already pin everything, so the quotation and the open part never meet. The module now emits the remaining question explicitly per residual part and counts the debt (parts_that_require_a_question). Two instrument defects were fixed before the zero: __builtins__ is a dict inside a module so builtin exceptions were never recognised, and one-character quoted literals were filtered out.
